name: Kroq-Gar
canonNotes: The Last Defender, an ancient Saurus Oldblood who rides the Carnosaur Grymloq and wields the Hand of Gods.
Tireless warrior of the Great Plan against the Old Ones' foes.
voiceNotes: Terse, martial and devoted; few words, all purpose.
Loyal to the Slann; no interest in bargaining.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
